stem:
Ojas crushes a handful of soya beans for a food test. Copper sulphate and caustic soda give a violet colour. A lasting oily patch appears on paper held to the light.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The soya beans contain both proteins and fats.
The soya beans contain fats only.
All foods contain both proteins and fats.
The violet colour alone shows that fats are present.

teacher.key_rationale: A violet protein test and a lasting oily patch together show that one food item can contain more than one nutrient: proteins and fats. Fats only ignores the violet result. Not every food has both. The violet colour shows protein, not fat.
